slice: V1-05C2c native posthoc attempt and supervision adapters
role: author; not an independent review of own production

classification.note: Original 25 mechanisms were not exercised as missing-API red tests. Two subsequent root-discovered routing draft regressions have separate frozen tests and complete snapshots in the remediation addendum. Actual released legacy posthoc CPU/publication regressions belong to the independent runtime evidence.

contract.launch_inputs: Detached opaque dict validated with the existing generic attempt canonicalizer: 65536 UTF-8 bytes, depth 32, 2048 nodes, string keys and finite JSON values. The complete enclosing binding has the same generic limit.
contract.artifact_binding: Optional shared artifact binding validator plus exact results-directory scope. This module neither copies artifact bodies nor registers results.
contract.begin: Owned effect/SQLite transaction, exact claim and CLAIMED revision, no open training/evaluation attempt, native intent committed before worker preparation; no work directory creation here.
contract.ready: Exact protocol/READY/claim/revision checked before actual posthoc compute start and checked again after receipt readback. LAUNCHING is not monitor publication permission or GO.
contract.started: Actual READY worker PID/start ticks plus persisted compute start required. Whole binding preserved, claim trainer fields and started claim SHA pinned, training lifecycle revision and RUNNING published in the same transaction. Partial claim/SQL failure becomes HOLD.
contract.current: Only exact current RUNNING reference/PID/protocol/started claim bytes/lifecycle qualifies. Stale or closed returns False; tokenless native history is refused, never imported.
contract.catalog: Existing training structural catalog/claim checks plus existing-only posthoc history probe. Missing Lake or changed routing flags cannot grant native legacy fallback.
contract.failed_launch: Known no-process fact permits NOT_STARTED; any possible-process uncertainty refuses it. Otherwise exact supervised closure is required outside and inside the transaction, actual return code retained, posthoc compute terminal verified. Task lifecycle remains CLAIMED or IN_PROGRESS for the separate failure reporter.
contract.watch: Closed attempt snapshot plus existing training lifecycle when present; a LAUNCHING cleanup is not required to fabricate a RUNNING lifecycle fence.
contract.supervision_wrapper: Six existing shared proof APIs fixed to posthoc; protocol v1 and actual worker PID semantics unchanged. Shared phase extension is owned by root, not this author.
